files.README.md:
# Tarnhelm Sensors - field rig build file

The build file defines one mapping, anchored as sensor-defaults, that carries the image, the retry count and
the runner tag every rig job shares. Jobs list their own extra settings next to the shared ones.
files.notes/rig-jobs.txt:
Three rig jobs run on every change: probe, warm-up and report.
The warm-up job adds one extra setting of its own on top of the shared block.

turns.prompt: Tarnhelm Sensors keeps the settings its rig jobs share in one mapping anchored as sensor-defaults. Give the single line a job writes so that those shared settings are merged into the job's own mapping. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
